oe_cri2_pa_nobles_war_indemnity = {
	type = country
	estate = nobles_estate
	importance = 2.0

	potential = {
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_pam_noble_war_pay }
		OR = {
			at_war = yes
			war_exhaustion >= 3
		}
	}

	on_accept = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cri2_pam_noble_war_pay years = 5 mode = replace }
		change_societal_value = { type = aristocracy_vs_plutocracy value = societal_value_minor_move_to_left }
	}

	can_bribe = {
		can_bribe_default_trigger = yes
	}

	on_bribe = {
		on_bribe_default_effect = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 20
		subtract = { if = { limit = { estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = scope:target value > 0.6 } } value = 12 } }
	}

	chance = 10
}

oe_cri2_pa_clergy_famine_charity = {
	type = country
	estate = clergy_estate
	importance = 2.0

	potential = {
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_pam_clergy_charity }
		gold >= 50
	}

	on_accept = {
		change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -2.5 min = 30 max = 600 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cri2_pam_clergy_charity years = 5 mode = replace }
		if = { limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age } oe_cri2_bump_lia_relief = { amount = 1 } }
	}

	can_bribe = {
		can_bribe_default_trigger = yes
	}

	on_bribe = {
		on_bribe_default_effect = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 18
		add = { if = { limit = { OR = { any_province = { is_starving = yes } has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age } } value = 25 } }
	}

	chance = 10
}
